Hi Karthik and Laura,

We’re preparing to close out our Q2 renewal and need the final true-up invoice for RDW-5421 so we can route it through procurement. Can you send the final invoice with line-item breakout (true-up by model/usage), the PO number format to put on our side, and any EU VAT documentation Redwood will provide?

Two items to flag:
- Our AP needs a VAT registration certificate from Redwood to support zero-rating in our region — can you provide that as a PDF?
- Preferred payment flow is an ACH/Wire to our payment provider (we can also accommodate a direct transfer). If Redwood requires a payment portal, please share details.

Thanks — trying to get this scheduled into our July payrun.

Best,
Evelyn Marks
Finance Manager
Greenleaf.io

Laura —

Thanks for the draft. A couple quick clarifications from AP:
1) VAT certificate: we need the company registration number on the certificate to reconcile with our tax system — can Redwood include the number on the PDF?
2) Invoice currency: can you confirm the EUR amount is net of VAT and that Redwood will not charge EU VAT (we’re expecting reverse-charge).
3) For payment, Greenleaf prefers a single wire to our payments partner (Peter at PayGate). Can you put PayGate’s remittance reference on the invoice, or do you need Redwood to invoice PayGate directly?

If you can send the official PDF and the VAT cert with company registration number by EOD Friday (9 Jul), we can queue this into our mid-July payrun.

Best,
Evelyn
